doc: The weapons the player gets. Moves and damage rules are Dark Souls III's. The first build repurposes an existing Dark Souls III weapon row (same moveset, same numbers) and gives it Space Marine 2's sounds; Space Marine 2's models and numbers are a later upgrade (milestone 5).

ds3_weapon_class.doc: which Dark Souls III weapon supplies the moveset

model_source.doc: later upgrade (milestone 5); empty while the first build uses the Dark Souls III model

stats_source.doc: later upgrade (milestone 5); empty while the first build uses the Dark Souls III numbers

ds3_base_row.doc: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST row id of the Dark Souls III weapon that is repurposed (checked against the game's own table by the probe)

ds3_base_name.doc: that row's name in Dark Souls III (English); the text is replaced by display_name in memory only

ammo_row.doc: ranged weapons: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST row id of the ammunition (a stack whose count falls when the weapon fires)
